evidence: Plaut. Mil. 291b–292: Num tibi lippus videor?
Hor. Ep. 1.1.29: nōn tamen idcircō contemnās lippus inungī (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Horace’s proverb for common knowledge: known omnibus et lippīs et tōnsōribus (S. 1.7.3, Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: Num tibi lippus videor? — Medicum istuc tibi meliust percontārier.
phrases.english: Do my eyes look sore to you? — You’d better ask a doctor that.

phrases.latin: Lippī illīc oculī servos est simillimus.
phrases.english: That slave is just like a sore eye.
